title: Sampled Shadow Multiplexer (rate-fuse & credit caps)
creator: Asha Mehta
summary: Introduce a lightweight in-path multiplexer that duplicates a sampled subset of live requests to shadow model variants using a credit-pool and rate-fuse design to bound cost and prevent tenant interference.
spec: We will implement a 'Sampled Shadow Multiplexer' (SSM) component in the gateway layer that safely duplicates requests to shadow endpoints. Key features: 1) Deterministic per-request sampling based on a configurable hash (route + user_id + seed) to ensure reproducible test cohorts; 2) A cross-tenant credit pool plus per-tenant soft quotas to cap aggregate GPU/TPU token spend from shadowing; 3) 'Rate-fuse' logic that prevents bursts from oversubscribing the shadow fleet by smoothing conversions into a leaky-bucket plus short burst buffer; 4) Optional per-route priority weighting and per-variant backs-off when failures or latency regressions are detected; 5) Metadata tagging so each shadow request carries provenance and experiment ID for observability and replayability; 6) Admin API and console controls to set global caps, per-project allocation, and emergency kill-switch. Trade-offs considered: inline duplication increases gateway latency risk (mitigated via async fire-and-forget path and strict timeouts). Credit-pool favors global cost predictability over strict per-tenant fairness; soft quotas + tenant isolation policies allow quick quarantine. We opted for deterministic sampling and credit accounting rather than purely probabilistic reservoir sampling to improve reproducibility for A/B and canary evaluation. Integration points: gateway, router, cost accounting service, rollout controller, and console dashboards.
implementation_steps: Add SSM module to gateway with deterministic hashing sampler and configurable seed
Implement credit-pool service (in-memory + Redis fallback) with per-tenant soft quotas and global cap enforcement
Create rate-fuse/leaky-bucket adapter that throttles duplication into a burst buffer for shadow fleet
Propagate experiment metadata headers (X-Shadow-Experiment, X-Shadow-Seed, X-Shadow-Timestamp) and ensure redaction rules for PII
Expose control plane APIs and console toggles for experiment creation, budget allocation, and emergency disable
Instrument metrics and traces (see monitoring list) and add dashboard panels to Grafana
Add e2e tests and chaos tests simulating shard outages and credit exhaustion
Write migration and rollout scripts for staged enablement and rollback hooks
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic sampling produces stable cohorts across restarts when seed and route are unchanged
Shadow duplication respects global cap: total mirrored token spend does not exceed configured global budget under load tests
No measured >2% p95 increase in production request latency for routes with SSM enabled (fire-and-forget path verified)
Automatic quarantine triggers when per-variant error-rate delta >5pp or latency regression >30% versus baseline
Observability surfaced: shadow_duplicate_rate, shadow_cost_consumed, shadow_error_delta, shadow_latency_delta, and per-experiment cohort size
Admin API can disable any running experiment within <5s and console toggle shows live status
testing_plan: Unit tests for deterministic sampler, credit accounting, and rate-fuse behavior
Load-test shadow duplication at 10x expected traffic in k8s staging to validate caps and burst handling
Chaos test: bring down shadow fleet and ensure gateway falls back without blocking mainline traffic
Synthetic canary: replay stored production traces with sampling seed to validate reproducible cohorts
Integration test with cost-accounting pipeline to verify accurate token billing attribution
Security review for header propagation and PII redaction in collaboration with Security team
rollout_plan: Phase 0 - Feature flag off: merge behind feature flag and enable internal-only experiments
Phase 1 - 0.1% global traffic: create default experiment, track metrics for 72 hours
Phase 2 - 1% traffic with per-route weighting and credit caps for 7 days
Phase 3 - 5-10% traffic with production experiments and tie to cost dashboards
Emergency rollback: console kill-switch + automated rule to disable experiment when error or cost thresholds breached
monitoring_and_alerting: grafana:panel /d/abcd/shadow-multiplexer - live cohort counts and cost burn rate
alert:ShadowErrorSpike (trigger when delta > 5 percentage points for 10m)
estimated_cost_impact: Expected additional cost: 0.5-3% of GPU token spend at 1% duplication; bounded by credit pool. Operational overhead for credit accounting ~ small steady compute + Redis footprint.
risk_mitigation: Keep duplication async and bounded by strict timeouts to avoid mainline latency impact
Implement quick kill-switch that disables duplication across all gateways via control plane
Per-tenant soft quotas and automatic quarantine to protect low-credit customers
Conservative default: sample low initially and expose easy knobs in console for escalation
Add regression evaluators that compare shadow model outputs to baseline and signal drift early
